name: Kim Eng
reason: Teaching pair with Eckhart Tolle, who is already on Spiritpedia: her own site (presencethroughmovement.com, 6 Nov 2026) presents Presence Through Movement as a companion workshop to Eckhart's talks, her retreats are joint ones with him (latest listed, Omega, Sept 2025, is past), her products sit in his shop (shop.eckharttolle.com) and her community offer is his Eckhart Tolle Now membership. Per the brief, a couple who teach together stay one listing (the better-known partner), so she belongs in Eckhart Tolle's bio rather than a separate page. Her site also publishes no email or contact form of her own.
